{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVMdNDs8AAAABaymlLA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BnXy5zhEYic4", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BnXy5", "number": 58, "title": "Remove unnecessary MMD profile restrictions and accept structurally valid source data", "body": "## Problem

The draft extensions and PMX/VMD converter currently treat limitations of the bounded IK/physics executors and approximate glTF animation fallback as if they were invalid MMD source data. This rejects legitimate assets. The converter should **accept structurally valid MMD data by default, preserve it faithfully, and report unsupported execution separately**. Do not weaken malformed-file checks or resource-safety protections.

## Expected outcome

Separate four concerns: (1) source format validity, (2) lossless extension transport, (3) runtime capabilities, and (4) quality/availability of approximate core glTF fallback. Preserve valid-but-not-executable source records with explicit machine-readable diagnostics, never silently discard or misrepresent them. Resource budgets belong to implementations, not source-format validity.

## Tasks

### IK, bones and append
- [ ] Extend `MMD_skeleton_solver` beyond single-axis `hinge` links to retain all PMX three-axis angular limits, including multi-axis and locked triples. Update schemas, import/export, validator, solver and tests.
- [ ] Preserve fixed-axis, local-axis and external-parent bone metadata; implement execution where supported, otherwise report an unresolved binding/capability rather than rejecting valid conversion.
- [ ] Review strict parent/append ordering, IK link ancestry/order and physics-phase rules; preserve source order and layer/phase metadata, distinguish actually invalid graph references/cycles from graphs unsupported by the current solver.
- [ ] Remove format-level arbitrary IK iteration/link/work caps; validate true source-format limits and apply safe configurable execution budgets at runtime.

### Physics
- [ ] Represent free 6DoF axes encoded by inverted joint lower/upper limits; do not reject/swap/clamp valid source values as invalid.
- [ ] Move rigid-body/joint count caps and seek/replay/update/settle time budgets out of data-validity rules; implement safe bounded/checkpointed/chunked execution or report execution limits without rejecting asset transport.
- [ ] Preserve valid but currently unexecuted features (impulse morphs, soft bodies, multiple body writers, cross-phase dependencies) with transparent capability/loss reports; never claim unsupported simulation is equivalent.
- [ ] Compare and document original-MMD timing/ordering (1/60 s shared Bullet world, substeps, pre/post-physics, mode 2, writeback) using reverse-engineering evidence and actual comparison tests where possible.

### VMD / animation
- [ ] Do not fail preservation of exact retained VMD motion solely because adaptive core glTF fallback exceeds its 200,000-sample budget, FLOAT seam constraints, or quality tolerances. Report fallback limitations separately and retain a usable approximation when possible.
- [ ] Allow unrelated glTF animation channels alongside extension-owned bone/weight channels while avoiding double animation.
- [ ] Preserve and expose VMD visibility/IK controls, camera/light/shadow sections and older MMD-accepted VMD variants; separate runtime feature support from input acceptance. Support opt-in name-based cross-model binding/retargeting with explicit ambiguity handling.

### Validation / compatibility
- [ ] Return precise diagnostics for malformed data vs valid-but-unexecuted features vs fallback approximation limits vs resource exhaustion.
- [ ] Version and update `MMD_skeleton_solver`, `MMD_physics`, `MMD_animation_vmd` schemas/READMEs/converter/plugins without reinterpreting existing serialized versions.
- [ ] Add conversion, roundtrip/reload and negative fixtures covering multi-axis/locked IK, fixed/external bones, free joint axes, long motions/seeks, large-but-valid counts, and unrelated channels. Retain rejection tests for corrupt references and unsafe resource use.
- [ ] Add original-MMD/MikuDanceStudio comparison fixtures and clearly distinguish measured fidelity from project policies.

## Context and reproduction

Current restrictions are documented or enforced in:
- [IK extension](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/extensions/MMD_skeleton_solver/README.md), [PMX single-axis rejection](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/tools/pmx-solver.ts#L76-L105), [solver validation](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/packages/mmd-solver/index.ts#L139-L264)
- [Physics extension](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/extensions/MMD_physics/README.md), [physics validation](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/packages/mmd-physics/index.ts), [seek budgets](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/packages/three-mmd-physics/world.ts#L319-L350)
- [VMD extension](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/extensions/MMD_animation_vmd/README.md), [VMD reader/fallback policy](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/vmd.md)

Reverse-engineering reference: [jstzwj/MikuDanceStudio](https://github.com/jstzwj/MikuDanceStudio) (behavior-level reimplementation of MMD v9.32 x64). Compare [PMX IK limit reader](https://github.com/jstzwj/MikuDanceStudio/blob/main/src/model/pmx_load.cpp#L809-L883), [Euler limits/fixed-axis IK](https://github.com/jstzwj/MikuDanceStudio/blob/main/src/model/bone_transform.cpp#L691-L830), [physics scheduling](https://github.com/jstzwj/MikuDanceStudio/blob/main/src/physics/physics_frame.cpp#L1-L58), [Bullet joints](https://github.com/jstzwj/MikuDanceStudio/blob/main/src/physics/physics_create.cpp#L348-L374), and [VMD model-name behavior](https://github.com/jstzwj/MikuDanceStudio/blob/main/src/model/vmd_load.cpp#L308-L327). Reconstructed code is evidence, not proof of exact original fidelity.

Related bounded-profile issues: #29, #43, #45, #47.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Representative MMD-format-valid source assets no longer fail conversion solely for unsupported IK/physics/fallback execution; extension data roundtrips or a documented lossless retention path is available.
- [ ] Invalid/corrupt files and dangerous resource requests still fail safely and clearly; runtime inability is not presented as source-format invalidity.
- [ ] Multi-axis/locked IK, free joint limits, preserved-but-unexecuted features, and long/complex VMD animations are covered by tests.
- [ ] Existing extension payload versions remain compatible, and new schema versions and runtime capability rules have fixtures and documentation.
- [ ] Unsupported playback is not silently approximated as exact; relevant Node/browser/GLB/glTF tests pass.

## Optional validation

Windows comparison with original MMD v9.32 and MikuDanceStudio for IK, physics and VMD parity; record which observations are measured versus inferred.

## Required post-merge verification
